description: This file defines the DataAssetService class which manages the lifecycle, creation, retrieval, and state transitions of data assets within the project. It also includes internal methods for test setup and backward compatibility functions.

classes.name: DataAssetService
classes.description: Service for managing data asset lifecycle, state transitions, and related operations.

methods.name: None ensure_minimal_data_asset_for_tests(self, data_asset_id: str)
methods.description: Creates a minimal test data asset with predefined metadata, used for testing purposes.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_data_asset( self, draft_id: str, title: str, description: Optional[str], owner: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Creates a data asset from a draft, validates metadata, and queues a validation job.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_data_asset(self, data_asset_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a data asset by its unique identifier.

methods.name: None update_state( self, data_asset_id: str, new_state: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Updates the state of an existing data asset and logs the change via audit service.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] create_submission( self, draft_id: str, actor_user_id: str, actor_role: str, correlation_id: str, )
methods.description: Deprecated method for creating a data asset with default metadata for backward compatibility.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_submission(self, submission_id: str)
methods.description: Deprecated alias for get_data_asset for backwards compatibility.
